quarterly_data.signal: Customer Lektra: Penguin Solutions has been selected by Lektra to deploy and optimize its AI micro data centers. Through its Full-Stack AI Factory Platform, Penguin provides NVIDIA-based hardware, validated reference designs, AI-optimized compute and the engineering to design and integrate accelerated servers into Lektra's EdgeScale architecture, and as an NVIDIA AI Factory Specialized Partner it deploys infrastructure to remote sites and provides ongoing services. Lektra, described as a cloud company, runs AI data centers powered by distributed carbon-free energy at capacities of 20 MW or less, with eight sites already deployed and many more planned; the platform lets cloud service providers, neoclouds, energy providers, commercial solar operators and other site hosts add GPU capacity incrementally.
quarterly_data.figure: no specific figure (Lektra: eight sites deployed, sites of 20 MW or less)
